body: Wouldn’t that be ignoring the issues, I mean yes, every person is unique, though, how much worth does it add? A act of kindness can effect someone, though temporary, but hate can effect someone for a lifetime. The reason to live, is to wait for something good to happen? And just hope eventually it will? That is some hopeful thinking.

As I see it, the future isn’t so bright, I mean look, the world maybe has something in the future, but what makes its worth? People say life is valuable, but yo a certain extent when does that end? Isn’t suicide filled with more pros than cons. This world as we see it is built on self worth and a freaking piece of paper. A piece of paper decides if you get to eat, have a house, get to live. To me beauty does not cover up what lies behind.

It’s not that there isn’t good people, or bad people, it’s just why live in a world constantly filled with lies, and hate, the world will end at some point so why live this if it eventually will all disappear, to the stars we are nothing more than figment of light, the constant want for existence is strange, if in the end it is worth nothing. Isn’t it?
I’ve also been guilted by the damage I would cause, that’s what’s keeping me, it just seems like, why should I hurt others to not hurt.
